banner.title: THE TOOLING DATA_FILES ADAPTATION - the rn git add and the rverify restore/count, the two-round untracked-defs lesson closed in the tools
banner.provenance: The tooling round of the data_files extension (the user Go call, 2026-10-23). The R792 run left 73 .lua defs untracked and the R793 run needed a hand add/commit/push for its 70 - both because rn derives the git add list from facts that predate the R791 data_files extension. rn now derives NDATA and DFILES from the spec and adds them after the preflight gate; rverify now restores the data paths from the base sha and counts them in n_patches so its double-run gate proves the emitted files exactly like a patch. The engine itself stays untouched. Registry 478 live, unchanged this round; the battery census reads loaded 478, errors 0.

file_patches.note: rn derives the data_files facts beside the file-patch facts
file_patches.from: EXTRA=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; print(' '.join(fp['file'] for fp in json.load(open('$SPEC')).get('file_patches',[])))")
file_patches.to:
EXTRA=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; print(' '.join(fp['file'] for fp in json.load(open('$SPEC')).get('file_patches',[])))")
NDATA=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; print(len(json.load(open('$SPEC')).get('data_files',[])))")
DFILES=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; print(' '.join(df['path'] for df in json.load(open('$SPEC')).get('data_files',[])))")

file_patches.note: the data-file echo line rides the fact block
file_patches.from:
if [ "$NFPATCH" -gt 0 ]; then
    echo "== file-patch round ($NFPATCH file patch(es)): $EXTRA go in the git add"
fi
file_patches.to:
if [ "$NFPATCH" -gt 0 ]; then
    echo "== file-patch round ($NFPATCH file patch(es)): $EXTRA go in the git add"
fi
if [ "$NDATA" -gt 0 ]; then
    echo "== data-file round ($NDATA data file(s)): $DFILES go in the git add"
fi

file_patches.note: the git add gains the data paths after the preflight gate
file_patches.to:
if [ "$NFPATCH" -gt 0 ]; then
    git add $EXTRA
fi
if [ "$NDATA" -gt 0 ]; then
    git add $DFILES
fi
